text:
Mira: Thinking out loud — we should add a 'Provenance inspector' in Console to let tenants quickly answer 'who changed routing/quota/rollout policy and when' and produce a downloadable artifact for compliance (signed bundle + optional redaction). Thoughts?
Ryan: +1. Two quick Qs: do we treat control-plane commits as source-of-truth or reconcile with runtime applied state? and do we surface ephemeral canary deltas?
Sam: I think show committed policy + a linked canary record if applicable. UI shows commit author + deploy id + small diff. Backend: GET /audit/changes?resource=route&since=...
Mira: Constraints: 1) snappy UI (no huge blocking queries) 2) don't leak PII 3) safe export for SOC (signed, tamper-evident).
Nina: PII/redaction is a must. We need per-tenant pseudonymization and an export opt-in that records an "export justification". Also retention controls for exported bundles.
Alexa: From ops: exports must be signed and resumable. Large exports -> NDJSON stream + resume token. Enforce per-tenant export quota and system rate-limits.
Casey: Devex ask: include a tiny request/response context sample in the export for evaluation teams, but mark it sensitive and gate behind an approval flow.
Tom: Implementation idea: add changeproof hash on each change record, then bundle signs the sequence with KMS. Consumers can verify with a public key. For canary changes, we need lineage links (which commit spawned the canary).
Ryan: Also think we should offer an "effective policy at time T" endpoint so audits can reproduce decisioning. Might be expensive to compute on the fly though.
Sam: We can generate snapshots lazily. Store weekly snapshots + diffs for fine-grained history. Cache snapshot results and invalidate on policy changes.
Mira: UX wishlist: show 'who', 'why' (free-text justification), 'scope' (tenant/global), 'delta' (compact diff), 'effective change' (preview), and an 'export' button with options: redacted / full / signed. Default to redacted.
Nina: Also require an "export justification" to be entered before export is allowed — creates an immutable audit entry.
Alexa: Quotas: per-tenant export tokens + cluster-wide throttle. Telemetry: emit events for export request, bundle prepared, and bundle download; include cost center tag.
ops-bot: scheduled job created: audit-exports-cleanup @infra (weekly)
Sam: API design debate — one flexible endpoint with query params vs multiple specialized endpoints. I prefer single endpoint (less surface area) but with clear shapes for response types.
Casey: :thumbsup: single endpoint + examples in SDKs. Make sure we have a JS example and a curl example.
Mira: Next steps: I will sketch a UI flow + mockups. Sam + Ryan please draft API contract. Nina do a privacy gap analysis. Alexa estimate infra/cost.
Ryan: I'll stub GET /audit/provenance and POST /audit/export draft by EOD.
Sam: I'll add caching hints + quota model to the API doc.
Nina: I'll circulate required redaction modes and field-level rules.
Mira: :raised_hands: Thanks all — I'll link the proposal here when done. Ping me if you want to pair on the contract"
